author: Veli Raiya
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, prefers realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Hiring illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly. Follow-up from author (09/21/26): thanks for reaching out; still checking portfolios; send a link to previous works if you have not already. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.
